t0.text: Unified interface (roadmap v2 "Just ask"): directions and information architecture

t1.text: 1 · One input box plus suggestions · the same panel on every page (iPhone)

t2.text: 1 · The same panel on iPad · keyboard up

t3.text: 3 · Home is the browser's start page

n1.text: Looks come from the WukongMind design system (ink, gold, jade, cinnabar; one gold ring for the Agent; seals, not capsules; no gradients): https://claude.ai/artifact/5fGhnS4fmcmWYZbPoKTTZ2. Its Composer, SuggestionRow, ToolRow, ResultCard, ScriptCard, Message, Seal, Switch, ListRow and BrowserBar are used throughout; the Logo on onboarding, the Mascot in panel states. Spec: docs/wukongmind/design-unified.md

n2.text: Compare the first two pairs: the title row ("Agent", the ink This page seal "talk.example.org · 2 scripts", ⋯ with model choice) and the input box are the same on a forum thread and an ordinary page. Only the suggestions differ. The status line shows only while a run is going and just after; tool rows use plain labels and fold into "Steps N" when the run ends. Code names, durations and tokens show only in developer mode.

n6.text: Suggestions never grey out: one that does not apply is not shown (a followed thread drops "Notify me…"; a dark page drops "Make it dark"). At most 4 fit; more scroll under a fade. One panel: on the three built-in forums, Summarize, Read it to me, Search this forum… and Notify call today's engines; typed text always goes to the Agent. One loop: every suggestion just sends its text.

n7.text: Gold and the ring mean only the Agent; jade means content from the website (result card headers, citation numbers); cinnabar means stop or error. Site type is internal: the This page seal shows the host and script count only, and the grey forum badge stays only on Home's site tiles.

n3.text: Menus are native Menus only: buttons (title, SF Symbol, optional subtitle), checkmarks, submenus, inline sections, destructive role. Every ⋯ is a Menu; the panel's ⋯ holds model choice. This page has switches, so it is a popover, never a menu. Mic: One panel dictates into the box (the bar's forum voice entry stays); One loop opens the voice session.

n4.text: iPad Settings is the same sheet and NavigationStack as on iPhone, only wider; pages push inside it. Dashed rows (M3, M4, Learn on ask) mark reserved places and are not built until their milestone.

n5.text: Onboarding 3: the "You're set" card appears after a run or Skip; it is drawn together with the prompts here. Step 3 runs in the real browser after the cover/sheet closes.

n8.text: Keyboard up: the status line folds into the header beside "Agent" (spinner + step) and comes back when the keyboard goes. The suggestion row stays while the box is empty and hides as soon as you type.

n9.text: This board draws One loop. The summary, search and read aloud are Agent tool calls. In One panel the same taps run today's engines, and their result text is attached as context to the Agent's next message, so the typed "point 2" follow-up works there too.

t7.text: Panel states: one mascot at most

n10.text: Mascot: wave fills the empty panel (128 pt). While working, one 40 pt pose sits inside the status line, before the text, and hides with it: think while waiting on the model, run while tools run, search while reading or searching; cheer when a run ends. It never floats over the conversation. One per screen.

t8.text: M3 · The Agent asks first, and shows its screenshots

t9.text: One loop · Saved answers and voice turns

n11.text: Confirmation card (design-m3 Confirmations): the ScriptCard shell (surface, hairline edge, radius-lg) under the waiting tool row, the question in plain ink text, the full URL (for cookies, the domain) in code style, then Allow (primary) and Don't allow (secondary), 44 pt. While it waits the status line reads "Waiting for your answer"; Stop also cancels the card. After Don't allow the row reads "Request not sent" (for cookies: "Cookies not read") and the Agent explains in the conversation.

n12.text: Screenshot thumbnail: the image at radius-md with a hairline edge inside the expanded tool row; a tap opens it full size in a sheet. A page-feedback warning uses the warning colour and icon, never cinnabar (cinnabar is only for real errors and Stop); its expanded row shows the before and after screenshots side by side, and the Agent goes on to check the page.

n13.text: Saved answer replaces AgentView for stored Research answers (design-one-loop "After approval"): the forum seal and date, the question, the answer as Markdown with citation chips, then the numbered sources list (DCSourcesList). No input box. Drawn as a page pushed from History; where it opens (History, or the panel as openAgentRun does today) is for the owner to confirm. Home's Recent opens the same view.

n14.text: Voice turns (design-one-loop "Voice", provisional until the spike): what you said is the user bubble and the voice model's reply is Agent text, each led by the waveform glyph in ink-muted. A hand-off runs the Agent like a typed request (Steps, result card). The session's controls stay in the Dock (design-unified).

t10.text: WUKO-77 · Safari-like bar, tabs and the provider model list (proposed, for the owner)

n15.text: One element morphs: the glass bar (back | address field with page menu and reload | tabs, Agent ring) narrows, lowers and rounds into the domain pill as you scroll down. Only your own scrolling drives it (not script scrolls, anchors, find or zoom): p = clamp(p + δy ÷ 64 pt) on every offset change, down collapses, up expands at once. It settles with a no-bounce spring under 250 ms when scrolling stops (p ≤ 0.5 opens). Tap, page end, load, address editing and the Agent finishing or asking spring it open. Reduce Motion: a 0.2 s cross-fade. Spec: docs/wukongmind/design-browser-bar-tabs-models.md

n16.text: Where the Agent lives: expanded, the gold ring at the trailing end (hold to talk, as today); collapsed, nothing to tap but the pill, and while the Agent works the lock becomes a turning ring with the scripts seal, so work stays visible. Home keeps the full bar with the mic. On iPad the mic sits in the bar and the ring toggles the side panel.

n17.text: Exceptions to the design system, taken for the owner (task D1 updates design-unified and the BrowserBar component): the bar and pill are Liquid Glass capsules (radius = height ÷ 2, as the system toolbar already ships on iOS 26), not radius-lg; and the morph is a third functional transition beside the two on the Motion board (settled: the owner asked for it).

n18.text: One conversation per tab (planned in design-unified; tabs are their own milestone, not M3). The panel follows the current tab, and a run stays bound to the tab it started in. A tab the Agent opens starts empty. Closing a tab stops its run and saves its conversation to History, with Undo (which doesn't resume the run). At most 30 tabs and 3 runs at once; a tab with a running Agent is never unloaded.

n19.text: The Models list is fetched per provider (with the saved key, from a local server, or a fixed list) (drawn from a real GET /v1/models on 2026-11-14: 15 Anthropic models). Star = favorite (the model menus list favorites). ⋯ › Use for Agent / Summaries replaces that role's model; the role seal moves. Scripts joins in M4. Use for Agent is disabled with a reason on providers without tool calling (today only Apple Intelligence).

t11.text: M4 · Import from a link, script powers, repair and the Scripts model

n20.text: Import review sheet (design-m4 "Import from a link"): a large sheet on iPhone, a form sheet on iPad. Top to bottom: name, author's version, author, the host it came from (outline seal); Runs on ("Every site" in danger for *://*/*); Can use in plain words ("Can send data to any site" for @connect *, and the GM_ai line, both in danger); Not supported here; Libraries with size; the code, read-only; Ask the Agent to review it (gold ring: it is the Agent). Add and turn on (primary) and Add, keep off stay pinned at the bottom; Cancel is in the bar. Nothing runs before Add.

n21.text: Update form: what changed comes first. A changed source host leads, in danger: "Now comes from <new>, was <old>". A script changed here adds "This replaces your changes. They stay in History." New hosts and rules carry a gold New seal and come before removals, then the line count, then the code. Update saves a new version. Can't add: one plain reason and "Nothing was installed." The other reasons use the same frame: "The file has no // ==UserScript== header", "The file is over 2 MB", "Only https links can be imported", "A library changed: <url> doesn't match its hash".

n22.text: Danger is always an icon plus words, never colour alone. The grey "Couldn't reach the model: <reason>" line is ink-muted with the cloud-off icon, never cinnabar: a service failure leaves the script on and offers no fix. Let the Agent fix it shows under any script with a script or api error, on or off, and in Script detail. After a repair the script card reads "Fixed" in success colour with Undo, which brings back the old version and its on/off state. Menu commands are rows under their script, for as long as the page is open.

n23.text: Settings › Scripts: the ⋯ toolbar Menu holds Import from link… (an alert with one link field, then the review sheet). Check for updates (on by default) and AI in scripts (on by default) are switches under Run scripts. An imported script with a newer version shows the gold Update available seal; tapping it opens the update form. Models: Scripts is a real role row; unset it reads "Same as Summaries". Its page has a Same as Summaries switch, then the usual provider and model rows.

t12.text: Learn on ask · learned sites, page tools and the site inspector

n24.text: Learn on ask (spec: docs/wukongmind/design-learn-on-ask.md, Suggestions and Developer mode part 2). A learned site adds no new screen for most people. Each frame's caption shows its whole suggestion row; a dashed chip shows only when search is learned (on this example site it failed): the same fixed suggestion chips, the same summary card, and a learned reader is an ordinary script in This page with one line, Reads this site. No text from a site or a learned tool ever becomes a chip, a tool name in the prompt or a label of the app.

n25.text: Asking: a website's own tool (site.*) asks before every call and warns before every trial run, whatever Confirm before writes says and whatever the page's hints claim; the hints show as the page's unverified claims. A script's own tool (script.*) follows Confirm before writes; a learned reader never asks (the app verified it and it only reads). Warnings use the warning colour and icon, never cinnabar.

n26.text: Site inspector and tool trial run exist only with developer mode on, from This page › Developer › Site inspector: a large sheet on iPhone, a form sheet on iPad, the trial run pushed inside it. Trust is always words plus an icon: Verified (success), Broken (warning), Failed (danger, a real error), Untrusted (warning). Page-written names, arguments and returns are set in mono. Forget this site clears the state, never the script.

t13.text: Motion and the address bar · ring states, Home over the page, Terms and consent

n27.text: Motion (spec: docs/wukongmind/design-motion.md). Tasks 1 to 5 and 7 are built; these boards were checked against simulator screenshots of the build on 2026-11-20. The iPad address-bar board is drawn from section 3 of the spec and marked "per design, iPad build pending" (Motion task 6). Home, the bar, onboarding, Settings and the Motion board above were updated in place: no address field on Home, no daily digest or podcast, pinned sites.

n28.text: Terms of Use and AI data consent show full screen on iPhone and iPad (on iPad the content sits in a centred column). The boards draw them on ground; the build still shows the system background (pure white or black), listed as a gap in design-motion.md.
